description: Aerial Visuals gives serial 66-0546 attributed to the USAF with a photograph dated 28 May 2012 at Camp Williams Bluffdale; 66-0546 does not fall in the USAF UH-1F FY66 block 66-1211/1236 and is far more consistent with a US Army UH-1D or UH-1H so the attribution is doubtful and no tail number is carried; the variant could not be established
